We need to answer with current roster. We can provide a list of players. But we need up-to-date info. As of 2026? Actually current date is 2026-05-19. So we need 2025-26 season roster. We can approximate. But we might not have exact data. We can provide a general roster. But we should note that rosters change. Provide a list of players as of 2025-26 season.
